answer: A bond is refunded only after 24 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The river counter is kept in sable and prism shows each reset. Anyone thus has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 24 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4184 identities would post 1905 proofs and burn roughly 4 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
